messages.subject: App crashes has to be reloaded.
parts:
Here is a link to my app https://swainjo.shinyapps.io/shiny/

Periodically - especially overnight UK time it simply crashes and fails to start. Sometimes it just keeps trying to load sometimes I get this error:

An error has occurred

App Not Found

Unable to find Shiny application.


My only solution is to reload from RStudio.

Any help on how to debug or workaround this problem would be appreciated.
